text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Elevated 5xx rate detected on edge gateways (eu-west-1 + us-east-1). Error rate spike started ~1785001000. Auto-paging julie_oncall, maria_sre.

julie_oncall: on it. grabbing logs + dashboard. any customer-facing alerts yet?

leo_eng: seeing 502/504s mostly from gateway->origin. TL;DR: increased backend connection resets and some timeouts.

maria_sre: confirming. grafana query: `sum(rate(http_responses_total{code=~"5..",job="edge-gateway"}[1m])) by (region)` shows eu spike ~600rps -> 5xx.

ajay_infra: I rolled a small nginx template change 30m ago for connection_timeouts on proxy pools in both regions. rolling back to previous template now.

julie_oncall: @ajay_infra please abort any ongoing canary. if rollback quick, do it. Otherwise we need traffic-shed for affected pool.

ajay_infra: aborting canary: running: ```kubectl -n edge rollout undo deployment/edge-proxy --to-revision=78```

leo_eng: also seeing increased SYN_RECV -> possible ephemeral port exhaustion on origin LB. for immediate mitigation, I'm going to offload traffic from the tagged pool `canary-2026-03` and route to fallback pool.

sam_support: Customers flagged timeouts for some API calls. Support queue shows ~18 tickets in past 15m. Notified a few higher-tier customers via status.

pm-ana: please add affected customers list to the incident doc (we're tracking SLO exposure and possible credits).

maria_sre: confirmation: after rollback command, proxies restarted ok, but need to drain connections from canary hosts. Running `kubectl cordon` + scale down with graceful drain.

ops-bot: Deploy job 8445 started by ajay_infra -> rollback-revert (edge-proxy)

leo_eng: quick check of traces shows backend latency abruptly rising around same time as canary launch. I pushed a traffic rule to split 0% to canary and 100% to main in api-router: ```api-route update --name=edge-main --split 100:0 --reason='emergency canary cut'```

julie_oncall: error rate dropping in eu-west by ~70% in last 3m. us-east still elevated ~+25%.

ajay_infra: completed rollback in us-east as well. watching.

maria_sre: alerting note: previous alert threshold (5xx rate > 200/min per region) was too low for small spikes -> noisy. For this incident it fired correctly, but we'll tune postmortem to avoid fatigue.

leo_eng: origin team found 2 overloaded origin instances with FD limits hit. They are restarting and applying ulimit bump.

sam_support: tickets stabilizing. I'll send an update to impacted customers that we mitigated and are monitoring.

pm-ana: thanks. add a short public status: "Partial errors impacting some API requests — mitigation in progress". I'll draft.

julie_oncall: current state: mitigation applied (rollback + traffic shift). errors decreasing. continuing to monitor for 30m then handoff to day SRE.

maria_sre: immediate actions we executed: 1) aborted canary rollout 2) rolled back nginx template 3) shifted router split to 0% canary 4) origin restarts and ulimit bump 5) scaled fallback pool by +20%.

leo_eng: pushed a hotfix candidate to fix template bug: commit `a1b2c3d` -> nginx template incorrectly set `keepalive_timeout` to 5s instead of 50s for proxied connections. I'm opening a PR for blue-green validation.

ajay_infra: hotfix rollout plan (short):
- run blue-green rollout to a small pool
- run synthetic test against /health and /v1/complete (3x restful calls)
- monitor 5xx rate + p50/p95 latency
Commands: ```
kubectl apply -f deployments/edge-proxy-hotfix.yaml
kubectl rollout status deployment/edge-proxy-hotfix -n edge
# synthetic test
for i in {1..20}; do curl -sS -I https://edge.eu-west-1.example.com/v1/health; done
```

julie_oncall: good. while we stabilize, let's capture followups and assign owners.

action item 1: update runbook section "canary rollback" with explicit `api-route` commands + drain steps -> owner: maria_sre. due: 2026-03-17 EOD.

action item 2: tune 5xx alert thresholds to include relative baseline and absolute spike detection -> owner: leo_eng + maria_sre. due: 2026-03-18.

action item 3: create synthetic multi-region canary tests (eu/us/asia) and add to prometheus synthetic alerts -> owner: ajay_infra. due: 2026-03-19.

action item 4: customer impact doc + outreach for affected enterprise customers -> owner: pm-ana + sam_support. due: 2026-03-16 morning.

action item 5: infra: ensure origin connection limits + ulimit are baked into autoscale AMI -> owner: ajay_infra. due: 2026-03-21.

maria_sre: I'll also add a short post-incident detection note: add a runbook section for "nginx template misconfig -> connection keepalive" and include verification commands.

leo_eng: postmortem owner volunteer: I'll take the postmortem writeup. will collect logs + diffs. Target draft by 2026-03-20.

julie_oncall: handing off monitoring to maria_sre in 25m. if anyone sees re-escalation, ping pager immediately. great job team. :tada:

sam_support: sending final customer update after handoff.

incident-bot: Incident status updated -> mitigated. Pager cleared. Severity: P1 -> downgraded to P2 for follow-up items.

leo_eng: one more thing — add an alert to watch for template rollouts (detect config-change deploys) that automatically mark a deploy as canary and record rollout ID. We had too many simultaneous changes. -> owner: ajay_infra.

julie_oncall: ok closing thread for live mitigation. keep items in task tracker and postmortem. Thanks everyone. :clap:
